title: A Fricke transformation for cubic-residue eta products of level 13
summary: We prove an explicit Fricke transformation for the two-dimensional space generated by normalized reciprocal products on the cubic-residue cosets modulo 13. The transformation matrix is a scalar multiple of a matrix of differences of cubic Gaussian periods. Its projective action is defined over the cyclic cubic field, whereas the normalized matrix is defined over the real cyclotomic field. The proof uses generalized eta functions, a modular unit of degree two on $X_1(13)$, and a five-coefficient identity.
